label: Paste
behaviour: Executes the default Paste command in the Clipboard group on Home when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Paste dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled in an editable document when the system or Office Clipboard contains pasteable content; disabled when the clipboard is empty.

label: Keep Text Only
behaviour: Pastes the current Clipboard contents at the active insertion point (or replaces the current selection) using the Keep Text Only paste option from Paste (Clipboard group on Home), with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the Clipboard contains rich or formatted text (such as copied Word text, HTML, or RTF) so text-formatting paste options apply. State rule: acts as a one-shot paste option tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open Paste menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Paste Special...
behaviour: Opens the Paste Special modal dialog to paste Clipboard contents as a specific format (Formatted Text RTF, Unformatted Unicode Text, HTML, Picture, or embedded/linked OLE object). Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable document (Format Painter copies formatting from the active selection and applies it to the next selected text range). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Set Default Paste...
behaviour: Opens the Word Options modal dialog on the Advanced -> Cut, copy, and paste section to configure default paste formatting behavior within and across documents. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable document (Format Painter copies formatting from the active selection and applies it to the next selected text range). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Cut
behaviour: Removes the currently selected text or object from the document and places it on the system and Office Clipboard. Enabled when a non-empty text range or deletable object is selected in an editable document; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection.

label: Copy
behaviour: Copies the currently selected text or object to the system and Office Clipboard while leaving the selection intact in the document. Enabled when a non-empty text range or object is selected in the document; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection.

label: Format Painter
behaviour: Copies character and paragraph formatting from the current selection on click (or locks Format Painter on double-click) and applies it to the next text range or object clicked in the document. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable document (Format Painter copies formatting from the active selection and applies it to the next selected text range). State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Format Painter brush mode is armed, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Office Clipboard...
behaviour: Opens or focuses the Office Clipboard task pane (Clipboard group on Home) to inspect, paste, or clear up to 24 collected clipboard items. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable document (Format Painter copies formatting from the active selection and applies it to the next selected text range).

label: Font
behaviour: Displays and sets the font family typeface for the current text selection in the Font group on Home, accepting direct typeface name entry or selection from its dropdown list. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable text range (body text, table cell, text box, header/footer, or footnote/endnote); disabled in Read Mode, protected regions, or when a non-text graphic frame is selected. State rule: shows the matching Font value as selected (on) when uniform across the selection, unselected (off) for other list entries, and a blank edit field (mixed) when the selection spans multiple Font values.

label: Font Size
behaviour: Displays and sets the font size in points for the current text selection in the Font group on Home, accepting direct numeric point entry (1 to 1638) or selection from its preset size list. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable text range (body text, table cell, text box, header/footer, or footnote/endnote); disabled in Read Mode, protected regions, or when a non-text graphic frame is selected. State rule: shows the matching Font Size value as selected (on) when uniform across the selection, unselected (off) for other list entries, and a blank edit field (mixed) when the selection spans multiple Font Size values.

label: Grow Font
behaviour: Increases the font size of the selected text (or the next typed character at the insertion point) to the next standard point size in the Font Size list. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable text range (body text, table cell, text box, header/footer, or footnote/endnote); disabled in Read Mode, protected regions, or when a non-text graphic frame is selected.

label: Shrink Font
behaviour: Decreases the font size of the selected text (or the next typed character at the insertion point) to the previous standard point size in the Font Size list. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable text range (body text, table cell, text box, header/footer, or footnote/endnote); disabled in Read Mode, protected regions, or when a non-text graphic frame is selected.

label: Change Case
behaviour: Displays the Change Case gallery in the Font group on Home with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ChangeCaseGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when the insertion point or selection is in an editable text range (body text, table cell, text box, header/footer, or footnote/endnote); disabled in Read Mode, protected regions, or when a non-text graphic frame is selected. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Sentence case.

Enabled when the redo stack contains an undone action or when the last editing command can be repeated; disabled (labelled Can't Repeat) when no redo or repeat action is available.

label: Ink to Shape
behaviour: Activates or deactivates automatic Ink to Shape conversion mode on Draw so freehand ink strokes matching geometric shapes convert immediately into Office drawing shapes. Enabled in an editable document on Draw when converting freehand ink strokes into geometric shapes (Ink to Shape) or typed math equations (Ink to Math). State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while automatic Ink to Shape mode is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Ink to Math
behaviour: Converts the selected handwritten ink strokes on the page into a typed OMath equation object (or opens the Math Input Panel when no ink is selected). Enabled in an editable document on Draw when ink strokes exist on the page (or are selected for conversion).

label: Drawing Canvas
behaviour: Inserts a resizable Drawing Canvas container at the insertion point on Draw to group ink strokes and drawing shapes together. Enabled in an editable document in Print Layout view when the insertion point is in the main body story to insert an ink Drawing Canvas container.

label: Ink Replay
behaviour: Replays the drawing sequence of ink strokes on the active page in chronological order with an interactive playback scrubber bar on Draw. Enabled in an editable document on Draw when ink strokes exist on the page (or are selected for conversion). State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Ink Replay playback session is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Ink Help
behaviour: Opens the Word Help task pane directly to the Draw and Ink documentation and tutorials. Enabled whenever the Draw tab is active to open ink drawing help and tutorials.

Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Align to Page is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Align to Margin
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Align to Margin mode from the Align menu (Arrange group on Layout). Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Align to Margin is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Align Selected Objects
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Align Selected Objects mode from the Align menu (Arrange group on Layout). Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Align Selected Objects is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Use Alignment Guides
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Use Alignment Guides mode from the Align menu (Arrange group on Layout). Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Use Alignment Guides is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: View Gridlines
behaviour: Toggles or selects the View Gridlines mode from the Align menu (Arrange group on Layout). Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when View Gridlines is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Grid Settings...
behaviour: Opens the Drawing Grid modal dialog to configure snap-to-grid, snap-to-other-objects, grid spacing, grid origin, and gridline display intervals. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Group
behaviour: Opens the Group dropdown menu in the Arrange group on Layout to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text.

label: Group
behaviour: Combines the two or more currently selected floating objects into a single grouped object that moves, resizes, and rotates as one unit. Enabled on Layout when two or more floating objects are multi-selected on the canvas; disabled when a single object is selected. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Ungroup
behaviour: Breaks the selected grouped drawing object apart into its constituent individual shapes or pictures. Enabled on Layout when an existing grouped object is selected; disabled when an ungrouped object is selected. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Rotate
behaviour: Displays the Rotate gallery in the Arrange group on Layout with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ObjectRotateGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Rotate Right 90°
behaviour: Rotates or flips the selected object by applying Rotate Right 90° from Rotate (Arrange group on Layout), with live preview on hover. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot rotation or flip command tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Rotate Left 90°
behaviour: Rotates or flips the selected object by applying Rotate Left 90° from Rotate (Arrange group on Layout), with live preview on hover. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot rotation or flip command tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Flip Vertical
behaviour: Rotates or flips the selected object by applying Flip Vertical from Rotate (Arrange group on Layout), with live preview on hover. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot rotation or flip command tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Flip Horizontal
behaviour: Rotates or flips the selected object by applying Flip Horizontal from Rotate (Arrange group on Layout), with live preview on hover. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot rotation or flip command tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: More Rotation Options...
behaviour: Opens the Layout modal dialog on the Size tab to enter an exact rotation angle in degrees and configure scale and aspect-ratio settings. Enabled on Layout when a floating picture, shape, text box, SmartArt graphic, chart, or 3D model is selected on the page (with Selection Pane always enabled in Print Layout / Web Layout view, and Bring Forward, Send Backward, Position, and Align active once the object uses non-inline text wrapping); disabled when the insertion point is in plain text. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Table of Contents
behaviour: Displays the Table of Contents gallery in the Table of Contents group on References with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (TableOfContentsGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Automatic Table 1
behaviour: Inserts the Automatic Table 1 table-of-contents building block from Table of Contents (Table of Contents group on References) at the active insertion point, or replaces the existing table of contents if the document already contains one. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: acts as a one-shot table-of-contents insertion or replacement tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Automatic Table 2
behaviour: Inserts the Automatic Table 2 table-of-contents building block from Table of Contents (Table of Contents group on References) at the active insertion point, or replaces the existing table of contents if the document already contains one. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: acts as a one-shot table-of-contents insertion or replacement tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Manual Table
behaviour: Inserts the Manual Table table-of-contents building block from Table of Contents (Table of Contents group on References) at the active insertion point, or replaces the existing table of contents if the document already contains one. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: acts as a one-shot table-of-contents insertion or replacement tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: More Tables of Contents from Office Online
behaviour: Selects or expands the More Tables of Contents from Office Online submenu under Table of Contents (Table of Contents group on References). Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Custom Table of Contents...
behaviour: Opens the Table of Contents modal dialog to configure page number display, right alignment, tab leader style, format template, number of heading levels (`Show levels`), and advanced TOC style mappings. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Remove Table of Contents
behaviour: Deletes the existing Table of Contents building block and `TOC` field from the document. Enabled on References when the document contains an existing Table of Contents; disabled when no Table of Contents is present. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Save Selection to Table of Contents Gallery...
behaviour: Opens the Create New Building Block modal dialog to save the currently selected Table of Contents into the Table of Contents gallery. Enabled in an editable document when a non-empty text range or object is selected on the canvas to save as a reusable building block; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: No Online Content Available
behaviour: Placeholder item shown inside More Tables of Contents from Office Online on References when online template content is unavailable or not yet fetched. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: remains disabled and unselected (off) at all times; checked (on) and mixed states are not used.

label: Add Text
behaviour: Displays the Add Text gallery in the Table of Contents group on References with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (TableOfContentsAddTextGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: Do Not Show in Table of Contents
behaviour: Applies the Do Not Show in Table of Contents gallery preset from Add Text (Table of Contents group on References) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: appears selected (on) in the Add Text gallery when the current selection uniformly matches Do Not Show in Table of Contents, unselected (off) when another preset or custom formatting applies, and unselected (mixed) when the selection spans multiple presets.

label: Level 1
behaviour: Applies the Level 1 gallery preset from Add Text (Table of Contents group on References) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: appears selected (on) in the Add Text gallery when the current selection uniformly matches Level 1, unselected (off) when another preset or custom formatting applies, and unselected (mixed) when the selection spans multiple presets.

label: Level 2
behaviour: Applies the Level 2 gallery preset from Add Text (Table of Contents group on References) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: appears selected (on) in the Add Text gallery when the current selection uniformly matches Level 2, unselected (off) when another preset or custom formatting applies, and unselected (mixed) when the selection spans multiple presets.

label: Level 3
behaviour: Applies the Level 3 gallery preset from Add Text (Table of Contents group on References) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Update Table and Remove Table of Contents requiring an existing Table of Contents in the document). State rule: appears selected (on) in the Add Text gallery when the current selection uniformly matches Level 3, unselected (off) when another preset or custom formatting applies, and unselected (mixed) when the selection spans multiple presets.

label: Update Table...
behaviour: Updates the existing Table of Contents field in the document, prompting whether to update page numbers only or rebuild the entire table from heading styles. Enabled on References when the document contains a Table of Contents; disabled when no Table of Contents exists in the document.

label: Insert Footnote
behaviour: Inserts a sequentially numbered footnote reference mark at the current insertion point and moves the cursor to the footnote area at the bottom of the current page. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Next Footnote and Show Notes requiring at least one existing footnote or endnote).

label: Insert Endnote
behaviour: Inserts a sequentially numbered endnote reference mark at the current insertion point and moves the cursor to the endnote area at the end of the document or section. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Next Footnote and Show Notes requiring at least one existing footnote or endnote).

label: Next Footnote
behaviour: Executes the default Next Footnote command in the Footnotes group on References when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Next Footnote dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes.

label: Next Footnote
behaviour: Moves the insertion point forward to the next footnote reference mark in the document. Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Previous Footnote
behaviour: Moves the insertion point backward to the preceding footnote reference mark in the document. Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Next Endnote
behaviour: Moves the insertion point forward to the next endnote reference mark in the document. Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Previous Endnote
behaviour: Moves the insertion point backward to the preceding endnote reference mark in the document. Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Show Notes
behaviour: Jumps the insertion point between the active footnote/endnote reference mark in body text and the corresponding note text in the footnote/endnote area (prompting to choose Footnote or Endnote area when both exist). Enabled on References when the document contains at least one footnote or endnote; disabled when the document has no footnotes or endnotes.

label: Footnote and Endnote Dialog...
behaviour: Opens the Footnote and Endnote modal dialog (Footnotes group on References) to configure note placement, numbering format, custom marks, start number, and numbering continuity. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in the main document body story (with Next Footnote and Show Notes requiring at least one existing footnote or endnote).

label: Insert Citation
behaviour: Opens the Insert Citation dropdown menu in the Citations & Bibliography group on References to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet).

label: Add New Source...
behaviour: Opens the Create Source modal dialog to enter bibliographic metadata (author, title, year, publisher, journal, URL, DOI) for a new source and insert its citation at the cursor. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Add New Placeholder...
behaviour: Opens the Placeholder Name modal dialog to insert a short tag citation placeholder whose full bibliographic details can be completed later in Source Manager. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Manage Sources...
behaviour: Opens the Source Manager modal dialog to search, sort, copy, edit, delete, and create bibliographic citation sources across the Master List and the Current List. Enabled in an editable document (including when the current document has zero citations, allowing access to the Master List of bibliographic sources); disabled in Read Mode or restricted-editing views.

label: Style
behaviour: Selects the active document-wide bibliographic citation style (such as APA, Chicago, GOST, Harvard, IEEE, ISO 690, MLA, SIST02, or Turabian) from the Style dropdown list in the Citations & Bibliography group on References. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: shows the active Style setting as selected (on), unselected (off) for inactive list entries, and mixed state is not used (always displays the single active setting).

label: Bibliography
behaviour: Displays the Bibliography gallery in the Citations & Bibliography group on References with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (BibliographyGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Bibliography
behaviour: Inserts or applies the Bibliography item from Bibliography (Citations & Bibliography group on References) at the active insertion point or selection. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot insertion or transformation tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: References
behaviour: Inserts or applies the References item from Bibliography (Citations & Bibliography group on References) at the active insertion point or selection. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot insertion or transformation tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Works Cited
behaviour: Inserts or applies the Works Cited item from Bibliography (Citations & Bibliography group on References) at the active insertion point or selection. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot insertion or transformation tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Insert Bibliography
behaviour: Inserts an unheaded `BIBLIOGRAPHY` field at the active insertion point listing all cited sources formatted in the active citation style. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Save Selection to Bibliography Gallery...
behaviour: Opens the Create New Building Block modal dialog to save the currently selected bibliography layout into the Bibliography building-block gallery. Enabled in an editable document when a non-empty text range or object is selected on the canvas to save as a reusable building block; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Change Provider
behaviour: Displays the Change Provider gallery in the Citations & Bibliography group on References with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (OfficeExtensionsCitationGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: highlights the tile matching the active document-wide preset as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when custom document settings outside the presets are in effect, and mixed state is not used (applies to the whole document, independent of text or section selection).

label: See More Add-ins...
behaviour: Opens the Office Add-ins Store dialog filtered to reference-management and citation-provider add-ins. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story that accepts citation or bibliography fields (with Manage Sources and Style also available when no citations have been inserted yet). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Insert Caption...
behaviour: Opens the Caption modal dialog to attach a numbered Figure, Table, or Equation caption label above or below the selected object (or configure AutoCaption rules). Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story or when a figure, table, or equation is selected (with Update Table enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Table of Figures field).

label: Insert Table of Figures...
behaviour: Opens the Table of Figures modal dialog to insert a generated directory of captioned figures, tables, or equations with page numbers and leader tabs. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story or when a figure, table, or equation is selected (with Update Table enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Table of Figures field).

label: Update Table
behaviour: Updates the Table of Figures field at the insertion point, prompting to update page numbers only or the entire table. Enabled on References when the insertion point is inside the corresponding Table of Figures, Index, or Table of Authorities field; disabled when the cursor is outside that field.

label: Cross-reference...
behaviour: Opens the Cross-reference modal dialog from the Captions group to insert a dynamic field link to a numbered item, heading, bookmark, footnote, endnote, equation, figure, or table. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point is in a text story or when a figure, table, or equation is selected (with Update Table enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Table of Figures field).

label: Mark Entry...
behaviour: Opens the Mark Index Entry modeless dialog to insert an XE index entry field for the selected text (or mark all occurrences) with main entry, subentry, cross-reference, or page-range options. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point or selection is in the main body story (with Update Index enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Index field).

label: Insert Index...
behaviour: Opens the Index modal dialog to compile and insert a formatted multi-column index from all XE index entry fields in the document. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point or selection is in the main body story (with Update Index enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Index field).

label: Update Index
behaviour: Recompiles and updates the INDEX field at the current insertion point to reflect added, modified, or removed XE index entries and current pagination. Enabled on References when the insertion point is inside the corresponding Table of Figures, Index, or Table of Authorities field; disabled when the cursor is outside that field.

label: Mark Citation...
behaviour: Opens the Mark Citation modeless dialog to insert a TA (Table of Authorities Entry) field for the selected legal case, statute, or treatise citation. Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point or selection is in the main body story (with Update Table enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Table of Authorities field).

label: Insert Table of Authorities...
behaviour: Opens the Table of Authorities modal dialog to compile and insert a formatted legal Table of Authorities grouped by category (Cases, Statutes, Other Authorities, or All). Enabled in an editable document when the insertion point or selection is in the main body story (with Update Table enabled only when the cursor is inside an existing Table of Authorities field).

label: Update Table
behaviour: Recompiles and updates the TOA (Table of Authorities) field at the current insertion point to reflect current TA citation fields and page numbers. Enabled on References when the insertion point is inside the corresponding Table of Figures, Index, or Table of Authorities field; disabled when the cursor is outside that field.

label: Envelopes...
behaviour: Opens the Envelopes and Labels modal dialog on the Envelopes tab to configure delivery and return addresses, envelope size, feed orientation, and print or prepend the envelope to the document. Enabled in an editable document to format and print standalone mailing envelopes or label sheets via the Envelopes and Labels dialog.

label: Labels...
behaviour: Opens the Envelopes and Labels modal dialog on the Labels tab to format and print a single label or a full sheet of mailing labels using the chosen vendor product number. Enabled in an editable document to format and print standalone mailing envelopes or label sheets via the Envelopes and Labels dialog.

label: Start Mail Merge
behaviour: Opens the Start Mail Merge dropdown menu in the Start Mail Merge group on Mailings to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled in an editable document to configure the mail-merge document type (Letters, E-mail Messages, Envelopes, Labels, Directory) and attach or edit a recipient data source.

label: Letters
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Letters mode from the Start Mail Merge menu (Start Mail Merge group on Mailings). Enabled in an editable document to configure the mail-merge document type (Letters, E-mail Messages, Envelopes, Labels, Directory) and attach or edit a recipient data source. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Letters is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: E-mail Messages
behaviour: Toggles or selects the E-mail Messages mode from the Start Mail Merge menu (Start Mail Merge group on Mailings). Enabled in an editable document to configure the mail-merge document type (Letters, E-mail Messages, Envelopes, Labels, Directory) and attach or edit a recipient data source. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when E-mail Messages is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Envelopes...
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Envelopes mode from the Start Mail Merge menu (Start Mail Merge group on Mailings). Enabled in an editable document to configure the mail-merge document type (Letters, E-mail Messages, Envelopes, Labels, Directory) and attach or edit a recipient data source. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Formatting is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Specific People
behaviour: Selects or expands the Specific People submenu under Show Markup (Markup group on Review). Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Reviewing Pane
behaviour: Executes the default Reviewing Pane command in the Markup group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Reviewing Pane dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane. State rule: the primary button reflects the active Reviewing Pane mode or pane state (checked/on when Reviewing Pane is active in the document or window, unchecked/off when inactive, and mixed state is not used because Reviewing Pane is strictly binary on/off).

label: Reviewing Pane Vertical...
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Reviewing Pane Vertical mode from the Reviewing Pane menu (Markup group on Review). Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane. Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Reviewing Pane Horizontal is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Change Tracking Options...
behaviour: Opens the Track Changes Options modal dialog (Markup group on Review) to configure insertion, deletion, moved-text, table-cell, and formatting markup indicators and colors. Enabled in an editable document to switch the markup display mode (Simple Markup, All Markup, No Markup, Original), filter visible markup by reviewer/type, or open the Reviewing Pane.

label: Track Changes
behaviour: Executes the default Track Changes command in the Tracking group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Track Changes dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled in an editable document to toggle Track Changes or accept/reject/navigate tracked revisions (with navigation and accept/reject commands requiring existing revisions or comments). State rule: the primary button reflects the active Track Changes mode or pane state (checked/on when Track Changes is active in the document or window, unchecked/off when inactive, and mixed state is not used because Track Changes is strictly binary on/off).

label: For Everyone
behaviour: Toggles or selects the For Everyone mode from the Track Changes menu (Tracking group on Review). Enabled in an editable document to toggle Track Changes or accept/reject/navigate tracked revisions (with navigation and accept/reject commands requiring existing revisions or comments). State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when For Everyone is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Just Mine
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Just Mine mode from the Track Changes menu (Tracking group on Review). Enabled in an editable document to toggle Track Changes or accept/reject/navigate tracked revisions (with navigation and accept/reject commands requiring existing revisions or comments). State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Just Mine is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Lock Tracking
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Lock Tracking mode from the Track Changes menu (Tracking group on Review). Enabled in an editable document to toggle Track Changes or accept/reject/navigate tracked revisions (with navigation and accept/reject commands requiring existing revisions or comments). State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Lock Tracking is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Accept
behaviour: Executes the default Accept command in the Tracking group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Accept dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments.

label: Accept and Move to Next
behaviour: Accepts the currently selected tracked revision and automatically advances the selection to the next revision in the document. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Accept This Change
behaviour: Accepts the currently selected tracked revision while keeping the insertion point at its current location. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Accept All Changes Shown
behaviour: Accepts all tracked revisions currently visible under the active reviewer/type markup filter. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Accept All Changes
behaviour: Accepts every tracked revision across the entire document while leaving Track Changes in its current state. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Accept All Changes and Stop Tracking
behaviour: Accepts every tracked revision across the entire document and turns off Track Changes. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Reject
behaviour: Executes the default Reject command in the Tracking group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Reject dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments.

label: Reject and Move to Next
behaviour: Rejects the currently selected tracked revision and automatically advances the selection to the next revision in the document. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Reject Change
behaviour: Rejects the currently selected tracked revision while keeping the insertion point at its current location. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Reject All Changes Shown
behaviour: Rejects all tracked revisions currently visible under the active reviewer/type markup filter. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Reject All Changes
behaviour: Rejects every tracked revision across the entire document (restoring original text/formatting) while leaving Track Changes in its current state. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Reject All Changes and Stop Tracking
behaviour: Rejects every tracked revision across the entire document and turns off Track Changes. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Previous
behaviour: Navigates the selection backward to the preceding tracked revision in the document. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments.

label: Next
behaviour: Navigates the selection forward to the next tracked revision in the document. Enabled on Review when the document contains tracked changes or comments (or when Track Changes is active); navigation and bulk accept/reject commands are disabled when the document has no revisions or comments.

label: Compare
behaviour: Opens the Compare dropdown menu in the Compare group on Review to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled whenever Word is open to compare two document versions or combine revisions from multiple authors into a consolidated document (with Show Source Documents enabled once a comparison result is active).

label: Compare...
behaviour: Opens the Compare Documents modal dialog to diff an original document and a revised document and display differences as tracked revisions. Enabled whenever Word is open to compare two document versions or combine revisions from multiple authors into a consolidated document (with Show Source Documents enabled once a comparison result is active). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Combine...
behaviour: Opens the Combine Documents modal dialog to merge revisions from two versions of a document by different authors into a single consolidated document. Enabled whenever Word is open to compare two document versions or combine revisions from multiple authors into a consolidated document (with Show Source Documents enabled once a comparison result is active). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Show Source Documents
behaviour: Opens the Show Source Documents cascade menu to hide source documents or display Original, Revised, or Both source panes alongside the comparison document. Enabled on Review after a document Compare or Combine operation has produced an active comparison document; disabled on standalone documents. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Block Authors
behaviour: Executes the default Block Authors command in the Protect group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Block Authors dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled only when editing a shared document hosted on SharePoint or OneDrive with active co-authoring; disabled on local documents.

label: Restrict Editing
behaviour: Shows or hides the Restrict Editing task pane or flyout in the document window from the Protect group on Review. Enabled in an editable document when the current user has permission to configure author locks or open the Restrict Editing task pane. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Restrict Editing task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Hide Ink
behaviour: Executes the default Hide Ink command in the Ink group on Review when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Hide Ink dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled when the document contains ink annotations on the page; disabled when no ink strokes exist in the document. State rule: the primary button reflects the active Hide Ink mode or pane state (checked/on when Hide Ink is active in the document or window, unchecked/off when inactive, and mixed state is not used because Hide Ink is strictly binary on/off).

label: Hide Ink
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Hide Ink mode from the Hide Ink menu (Ink group on Review). Enabled when the document contains ink annotations on the page; disabled when no ink strokes exist in the document. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Hide Ink is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Delete All Ink in Document
behaviour: Permanently deletes all handwritten ink strokes and ink annotations across the entire document. Enabled when the document contains ink annotations on the page; disabled when no ink strokes exist in the document. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Linked Notes
behaviour: Docks Word alongside Microsoft OneNote and starts a Linked Notes session so notes taken in OneNote automatically record a link back to the active Word document paragraph. Enabled when Microsoft OneNote desktop is installed so the active Word document can be docked and linked to a OneNote notebook page.

label: Read Mode
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Read Mode view or reading mode from the Views group on View. Enabled whenever a document window is open in Word to switch the active document view between Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, and Draft. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Read Mode view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Print Layout
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Print Layout view or reading mode from the Views group on View. Enabled whenever a document window is open in Word to switch the active document view between Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, and Draft. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Print Layout view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Web Layout
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Web Layout view or reading mode from the Views group on View. Enabled whenever a document window is open in Word to switch the active document view between Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, and Draft. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Web Layout view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Outline
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Outline view or reading mode from the Views group on View. Enabled whenever a document window is open in Word to switch the active document view between Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, and Draft. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Outline view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Draft
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Draft view or reading mode from the Views group on View. Enabled whenever a document window is open in Word to switch the active document view between Read Mode, Print Layout, Web Layout, Outline, and Draft. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Draft view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Focus
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Focus view or reading mode from the Immersive group on View. Enabled in an open document in Print Layout, Read Mode, or Web Layout view to enter Immersive Reader or toggle Focus mode. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Focus view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Immersive Reader
behaviour: Switches the active document window into Immersive Reader view or reading mode from the Immersive group on View. Enabled in an open document in Print Layout, Read Mode, or Web Layout view to enter Immersive Reader or toggle Focus mode. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active document window is in Immersive Reader view or display mode, unchecked (off) when another view or display mode is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window, independent of text selection).

label: Vertical
behaviour: Sets the Print Layout document viewport scrolling direction to Vertical so pages scroll continuously top-to-bottom. Enabled in an open document in Print Layout view; disabled in Read Mode, Web Layout, Outline, or Draft view. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Vertical page movement is active in the window, unchecked (off) when Side to Side page movement is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window).

label: Side to Side
behaviour: Sets the Print Layout document viewport scrolling mode to Side to Side so pages flip horizontally like a book. Enabled in an open document in Print Layout view; disabled in Read Mode, Web Layout, Outline, or Draft view. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Side to Side page movement is active in the window, unchecked (off) when Vertical page movement is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off across the active window).

label: Ruler
behaviour: Shows or hides the horizontal and vertical measurement rulers along the top and left edges of the active document viewport on View. Enabled in an open document window to toggle visibility of the horizontal/vertical Rulers, document Gridlines, and the Navigation Pane. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the document rulers are visible in the active window, unchecked (off) when hidden, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Gridlines
behaviour: Shows or hides the non-printing alignment gridlines over the page background in the active document viewport on View. Enabled in an open document window to toggle visibility of the horizontal/vertical Rulers, document Gridlines, and the Navigation Pane. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when document gridlines are visible in the active window, unchecked (off) when hidden, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Navigation Pane
behaviour: Shows or hides the Navigation Pane task pane or flyout in the document window from the Show group on View. Enabled in an open document window to toggle visibility of the horizontal/vertical Rulers, document Gridlines, and the Navigation Pane. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Navigation Pane task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Zoom...
behaviour: Opens the Zoom modal dialog to select a preset magnification (200%, 100%, 75%, Page width, Text width, Whole page, Many pages) or enter a custom percentage between 10% and 500%. Enabled in an open document window in Print Layout, Web Layout, or Draft view to adjust the document magnification factor and page-fit mode.

Sets the active document window's zoom magnification directly to 100%. Enabled in an open document window in Print Layout, Web Layout, or Draft view to adjust the document magnification factor and page-fit mode.

label: One Page
behaviour: Adjusts the active document window's zoom magnification so one full page fits vertically and horizontally inside the viewport. Enabled in an open document window in Print Layout, Web Layout, or Draft view to adjust the document magnification factor and page-fit mode.

label: Multiple Pages
behaviour: Adjusts the active document window's zoom magnification so two or more full pages are displayed side by side inside the viewport. Enabled in an open document window in Print Layout, Web Layout, or Draft view to adjust the document magnification factor and page-fit mode.

label: Page Width
behaviour: Adjusts the active document window's zoom magnification so the width of the page fills the horizontal width of the viewport. Enabled in an open document window in Print Layout, Web Layout, or Draft view to adjust the document magnification factor and page-fit mode.

label: New Window
behaviour: Opens a second independent document window (`:2`) showing another view of the same active document so different sections can be viewed or edited simultaneously. Enabled when at least one document window is open in Word (with View Side by Side requiring two or more open windows, and Synchronous Scrolling / Reset Window Position requiring View Side by Side to be active).

label: Arrange All
behaviour: Tiles all currently open, non-minimized Word document windows horizontally across the screen so all documents are visible at once. Enabled when at least one document window is open in Word (with View Side by Side requiring two or more open windows, and Synchronous Scrolling / Reset Window Position requiring View Side by Side to be active).

label: Split
behaviour: Splits the active document window horizontally into two independently scrollable panes (or removes the split if the window is already split). Enabled when at least one document window is open in Word (with View Side by Side requiring two or more open windows, and Synchronous Scrolling / Reset Window Position requiring View Side by Side to be active).

label: View Side by Side
behaviour: Arranges two open Word document windows side by side so both documents can be viewed and compared simultaneously. Enabled on View when two or more document windows are open in Word; disabled when only a single document window is open. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while View Side by Side comparison mode is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Synchronous Scrolling
behaviour: Links vertical scrolling between the two document windows in View Side by Side mode so scrolling either window scrolls the other in lockstep. Enabled on View only while View Side by Side is active across two open document windows; disabled when View Side by Side is inactive. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Synchronous Scrolling is enabled during View Side by Side, unchecked (off) when independent scrolling is used, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Reset Window Position
behaviour: Restores the side-by-side layout of the two document windows being compared in View Side by Side mode so they share the screen equally. Enabled on View only while View Side by Side is active across two open document windows; disabled when View Side by Side is inactive.

label: Switch Windows
behaviour: Opens the Switch Windows dropdown menu in the Window group on View to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled when at least one document window is open in Word (with View Side by Side requiring two or more open windows, and Synchronous Scrolling / Reset Window Position requiring View Side by Side to be active).

label: 1 Document1
behaviour: Toggles or selects the 1 Document1 mode from the Switch Windows menu (Window group on View). Enabled when at least one document window is open in Word (with View Side by Side requiring two or more open windows, and Synchronous Scrolling / Reset Window Position requiring View Side by Side to be active). State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when 1 Document1 is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Macros
behaviour: Executes the default Macros command in the Macros group on View when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Macros dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled whenever a document is open and macro execution/recording is permitted by Trust Center Macro Settings (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is active).

label: View Macros
behaviour: Opens the Macros modal dialog (Alt+F8) from the View -> Macros menu to run, edit, create, or delete VBA macros. Enabled whenever a document is open and macro execution/recording is permitted by Trust Center Macro Settings (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is active). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Record Macro...
behaviour: Opens the Record Macro modal dialog from the View -> Macros menu to start recording user actions as a VBA macro (or stops recording if active). Enabled whenever a document is open and macro execution/recording is permitted by Trust Center Macro Settings (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is active). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Pause Recording
behaviour: Pauses or resumes the active VBA macro recorder from the View -> Macros menu. Enabled only while VBA macro recording is actively running; disabled when no macro is being recorded. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Properties
behaviour: Shows or hides the Properties task pane or flyout in the document window from the SharePoint group on View. Enabled on View when the active document is associated with SharePoint document library metadata or server properties; disabled on local documents without server properties. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Properties task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Visual Basic
behaviour: Opens the Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) Integrated Development Environment (Alt+F11) to edit modules, user forms, and class code. Enabled whenever Word is open and VBA macro tooling is installed (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is actively running).

label: Macros
behaviour: Opens the Macros modal dialog (Alt+F8) to run, step into, edit, create, delete, or organize VBA macros in active templates and documents. Enabled whenever Word is open and VBA macro tooling is installed (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is actively running).

label: Record Macro...
behaviour: Opens the Record Macro modal dialog to assign a macro name, storage template, toolbar button, or keyboard shortcut and start recording user actions as VBA code (or stops recording if active). Enabled whenever Word is open and VBA macro tooling is installed (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is actively running).

label: Pause Recording
behaviour: Temporarily pauses or resumes the active VBA macro recorder so intermediate actions are excluded from the recorded macro. Enabled only while VBA macro recording is actively running; disabled when no macro is being recorded.

label: Macro Security
behaviour: Opens the Trust Center modal dialog directly on the Macro Settings page to configure VBA macro execution policy and trusted developer access. Enabled whenever Word is open and VBA macro tooling is installed (with Pause Recording enabled only while macro recording is actively running).

label: Add-ins
behaviour: Opens the Office Add-ins modal dialog to browse, install, and launch web-based Office Store and organization-deployed add-ins. Enabled whenever Word is open to manage Office Store add-ins, global Word templates (DOTM or DOTX), and COM add-ins.

label: Word Add-ins...

label: Properties

Enabled on Developer in any editable Word document (including OpenXML DOCX/DOCM and legacy Word 97-2003 DOC/DOT compatibility-mode documents) when the insertion point or selection is inside a content control or legacy form field; disabled in plain body text outside controls.

label: Group

Enabled on Developer when text or controls are selected for grouping or when the cursor is inside an existing grouped content control for ungrouping; disabled when no groupable selection or grouped control is active.

label: Group
behaviour: Wraps the currently selected text and content controls inside a grouped content control container so the block cannot be edited outside its child controls. Enabled on Developer when text or controls are selected for grouping or when the cursor is inside an existing grouped content control for ungrouping; disabled when no groupable selection or grouped control is active. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Ungroup
behaviour: Removes the outer group content control wrapper from the selected grouped block while leaving its inner text and child content controls intact. Enabled on Developer when text or controls are selected for grouping or when the cursor is inside an existing grouped content control for ungrouping; disabled when no groupable selection or grouped control is active. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: XML Mapping Pane

label: Block Authors

label: Restrict Editing

State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Restrict Editing task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Document Template

label: Modify Table Style...

label: Quick Styles
behaviour: Displays the Quick Styles gallery in the Shape Styles group on Shape Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when an AutoShape, text box, connector, or freeform shape is selected in an editable document; unavailable when no drawing shape is selected. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: All

Enabled when an AutoShape, text box, or WordArt object capable of holding text is selected in an editable document; disabled when a line or connector shape without a text frame is selected.
