label: Go to Header
behaviour: Moves the editing focus from the active section's footer story to the corresponding header story on the same page. Enabled while the Header & Footer story editor is active in Print Layout view to switch between header and footer stories or navigate across sections.

label: Go to Footer
behaviour: Moves the editing focus from the active section's header story to the corresponding footer story on the same page. Enabled while the Header & Footer story editor is active in Print Layout view to switch between header and footer stories or navigate across sections.

label: Previous
behaviour: Navigates the Header & Footer editor to the preceding distinct header or footer story (First Page, Odd Page, Even Page, or preceding section). Enabled on Header & Footer when multiple header or footer stories exist across document sections or First Page / Odd & Even page settings; disabled when the document has only a single header or footer story.

label: Next
behaviour: Navigates the Header & Footer editor to the next distinct header or footer story (First Page, Odd Page, Even Page, or subsequent section). Enabled on Header & Footer when multiple header or footer stories exist across document sections or First Page / Odd & Even page settings; disabled when the document has only a single header or footer story.

label: Link to Previous
behaviour: Links or unlinks the active section's header or footer story to the corresponding header or footer in the preceding section so it either inherits or defines independent content. Enabled on Header & Footer when editing the header or footer of section 2 or later in a multi-section document; disabled in section 1 because no preceding section exists. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the active header or footer story is linked to the preceding section (`Same as Previous`), unchecked (off) when unlinked, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Different First Page
behaviour: Enables or disables a separate First Page Header and First Page Footer for the active document section on Header & Footer. Enabled while the Header & Footer story editor is active in Print Layout view to toggle Different First Page, Different Odd & Even Pages, and Show Document Text for the section. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Different First Page is enabled on the active section, unchecked (off) when the first page shares the section's main header/footer, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Different Odd & Even Pages
behaviour: Enables or disables separate Odd Page and Even Page headers and footers across the document on Header & Footer. Enabled while the Header & Footer story editor is active in Print Layout view to toggle Different First Page, Different Odd & Even Pages, and Show Document Text for the section. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Different Odd & Even Pages is enabled on the document, unchecked (off) when odd and even pages share the same header/footer, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Show Document Text
behaviour: Shows or hides the dimmed main-body document text on the page while editing inside Header & Footer view. Enabled while the Header & Footer story editor is active in Print Layout view to toggle Different First Page, Different Odd & Even Pages, and Show Document Text for the section. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when main-body document text is visible while editing headers/footers, unchecked (off) when hidden, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

State rule: shows the active section's Header Position from Top measurement (on), default 0.5" offset (off) when at the standard position, and mixed state is not used (edits one active section header or footer story at a time).

label: More

label: LaTeX

label: Text
behaviour: Toggles Normal Text formatting on the selected characters inside the active OMath equation zone (rendering them upright/non-italic instead of math italic). State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the selected equation characters are formatted as Normal Text, unchecked (off) when formatted as math symbols, and indeterminate/mixed when the selection spans both.

label: Chart Design
behaviour: Appears under Chart Tools when an embedded DrawingML chart is selected; hosts chart element insertion, quick layouts, chart color palettes, chart style gallery presets, data source editing and chart type switching.

label: Add Chart Element
behaviour: Opens the Add Chart Element dropdown menu in the Chart Layouts group on Chart Design to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled when an Office chart is selected in an editable document to add or configure chart elements (axes, titles, data labels, gridlines, legend, trendlines) or apply a Quick Layout.

label: Axes

label: Switch Row/Column
behaviour: Swaps the data series mapped to the X (category) axis and the legend (series) entries on the selected chart. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible.

label: Select Data...
behaviour: Opens the Chart Data Range / Select Data Source modal dialog (alongside the chart's data grid) to edit legend series, horizontal category labels, and hidden/empty cell rules. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible.

label: Edit Data
behaviour: Executes the default Edit Data command in the Data group on Chart Design when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Edit Data dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible.

label: Edit Data
behaviour: Opens the compact embedded Chart in Microsoft Word Excel grid window to edit the chart's underlying data values in place. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Edit Data in Excel
behaviour: Opens the selected chart's underlying worksheet in a full Microsoft Excel application window for editing. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Refresh Data
behaviour: Reloads the selected chart's plotted values from its linked external Excel workbook data source. Enabled when an embedded or linked Office chart is selected in an editable document and its underlying Excel data sheet is accessible.

label: Change Chart Type...
behaviour: Opens the Change Chart Type modal dialog to convert the selected chart (or individual combo-chart series) to another chart type or subtype. Enabled when an Office chart is selected in an editable document to convert the chart to another chart type or subtype.

label: Format
behaviour: Appears under Chart Tools when an embedded DrawingML chart or chart element is selected; hosts chart element target selection, format pane opening, shape insertion, shape styles, WordArt styles, arrangement and chart dimensions.

label: Chart Elements
behaviour: Selects the active target chart element (such as Chart Area, Plot Area, Legend, Axis, or Data Series) from the Chart Elements dropdown list in the Current Selection group on Chart Tools Format. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when an Office chart or inner chart element is selected in an editable document to pick a target chart element, open its Format pane, or reset its style overrides. State rule: shows the active Chart Elements setting as selected (on), unselected (off) for inactive list entries, and mixed state is not used (always displays the single active setting).

label: Format Selection
behaviour: Opens the Format Chart Area / Format Selection task pane for whichever chart element is currently chosen in the Chart Elements selector. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when an Office chart or inner chart element is selected in an editable document to pick a target chart element, open its Format pane, or reset its style overrides.

label: Reset to Match Style
behaviour: Clears all custom manual formatting overrides from the selected chart element (or entire chart) so it reverts to the active Chart Style. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when an Office chart or inner chart element is selected in an editable document to pick a target chart element, open its Format pane, or reset its style overrides.

label: Shapes
behaviour: Displays the Shapes gallery in the Insert Shapes group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapesInsertGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when an Office chart is selected in an editable document to draw annotation shapes inside the chart area. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Change Shape
behaviour: Displays the Change Shape gallery in the Insert Shapes group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeChangeShapeGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when an inner chart drawing shape or rotatable plot element is selected on Format; disabled when the outer chart container frame is selected. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Quick Styles
behaviour: Displays the Quick Styles gallery in the Shape Styles group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when a chart container, plot area, data series, legend, or annotation shape is selected in an editable document. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: All
behaviour: Selects or expands the All submenu under Quick Styles (Shape Styles group on Format). Enabled on Chart Tools Format when a chart container, plot area, data series, legend, or annotation shape is selected in an editable document. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: More Colors...

label: Format Text Effects...
behaviour: Opens the Format Shape task pane on the Text Options tab to configure WordArt text fill, text outline, text shadow/reflection/glow/bevel/3-D effects, and text box layout. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when the chart container or a chart element containing text (such as a chart title, axis title, data label, or legend) is selected; disabled when a non-text plot line or gridline is selected.

label: Alt Text
behaviour: Shows or hides the Alt Text task pane or flyout in the document window from the Accessibility group on Format. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when an Office chart is selected to open or focus the Alt Text task pane. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Alt Text task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Position
behaviour: Displays the Position gallery in the Arrange group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (PicturePositionGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on Chart Tools Format when the outer chart frame or an inner annotation shape is selected (with z-order and alignment commands active when the chart uses floating text wrapping). State rule: highlights the tile matching the active target container or object preset as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when custom settings outside the presets are in effect, and mixed state is not used (operates on a single active container or object at a time).

label: In Line with Text

label: Add Assistant
behaviour: Inserts an Assistant subordinate shape branching beneath the currently selected node in an Organization Chart / hierarchy SmartArt diagram. Enabled when a SmartArt diagram or one of its inner node shapes is selected in an editable document to add shapes/bullets, toggle the Text Pane, promote/demote nodes, or reorder layout. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Add Bullet
behaviour: Inserts a new second-level bulleted text line inside the currently selected SmartArt node shape. Enabled on SmartArt Design when an inner SmartArt node or text-pane item is selected in a layout level that permits adding bullets, promoting/demoting hierarchy level, or reordering siblings; disabled when the outer SmartArt frame is selected or the selected node is at the boundary level.

label: Text Pane
behaviour: Shows or hides the Text Pane task pane or flyout in the document window from the Create Graphic group on SmartArt Design. Enabled when a SmartArt diagram or one of its inner node shapes is selected in an editable document to add shapes/bullets, toggle the Text Pane, promote/demote nodes, or reorder layout. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Text Pane task pane or flyout is open in the document window, unchecked (off) when the pane or flyout is closed, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Promote
behaviour: Promotes the selected SmartArt node or bullet item one level higher in the diagram's hierarchy. Enabled on SmartArt Design when an inner SmartArt node or text-pane item is selected in a layout level that permits adding bullets, promoting/demoting hierarchy level, or reordering siblings; disabled when the outer SmartArt frame is selected or the selected node is at the boundary level.

label: Demote
behaviour: Demotes the selected SmartArt node or bullet item one level lower (making it a child of the preceding item) in the diagram's hierarchy. Enabled on SmartArt Design when an inner SmartArt node or text-pane item is selected in a layout level that permits adding bullets, promoting/demoting hierarchy level, or reordering siblings; disabled when the outer SmartArt frame is selected or the selected node is at the boundary level.

label: Right to Left
behaviour: Flips the horizontal flow direction of the selected SmartArt diagram between Left-to-Right and Right-to-Left layout in the Create Graphic group on SmartArt Design. Enabled when a SmartArt diagram or one of its inner node shapes is selected in an editable document to add shapes/bullets, toggle the Text Pane, promote/demote nodes, or reorder layout. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the SmartArt diagram is arranged Right-to-Left, unchecked (off) when Left-to-Right, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Move Before
behaviour: Moves the selected SmartArt shape one position earlier (up/left) among its sibling shapes in the diagram sequence. Enabled on SmartArt Design when an inner SmartArt node or text-pane item is selected in a layout level that permits adding bullets, promoting/demoting hierarchy level, or reordering siblings; disabled when the outer SmartArt frame is selected or the selected node is at the boundary level.

label: Move After
behaviour: Moves the selected SmartArt shape one position later (down/right) among its sibling shapes in the diagram sequence. Enabled on SmartArt Design when an inner SmartArt node or text-pane item is selected in a layout level that permits adding bullets, promoting/demoting hierarchy level, or reordering siblings; disabled when the outer SmartArt frame is selected or the selected node is at the boundary level.

label: Layout
behaviour: Opens the Layout dropdown menu in the Create Graphic group on SmartArt Design to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled when an organization-chart or hierarchy node is selected inside a SmartArt diagram; disabled on non-hierarchy SmartArt layouts.

label: Standard
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Standard mode from the Layout menu (Create Graphic group on SmartArt Design). Enabled when a SmartArt diagram or one of its inner node shapes is selected in an editable document to add shapes/bullets, toggle the Text Pane, promote/demote nodes, or reorder layout. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Standard is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

Enabled when a SmartArt diagram is selected in an editable document to discard manual formatting overrides and restore the diagram's default style.

label: Format
behaviour: Appears under SmartArt Tools when a SmartArt diagram or diagram node is selected; hosts 2-D editing, shape geometry changes, shape styles, WordArt text styles, arrangement and diagram/node sizing.

label: Edit in 2-D
behaviour: Temporarily switches a 3-D-styled SmartArt diagram into a flat 2-D editing view while selected so inner node shapes can be resized, dragged, or formatted on SmartArt Format. Enabled on SmartArt Format when a 3-D SmartArt Quick Style is applied to the diagram so selecting the diagram temporarily switches it to a 2-D editing view; disabled when the SmartArt diagram uses a 2-D style. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the 2-D editing plane is active for the selected 3-D SmartArt diagram, unchecked (off) when viewing the rendered 3-D scene, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Change Shape
behaviour: Displays the Change Shape gallery in the Shapes group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeChangeShapeGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on SmartArt Format when one or more inner SmartArt node shapes are selected inside the diagram; disabled when only the outer SmartArt container frame is selected. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Rectangle
behaviour: Replaces the geometry of the selected shape with the Rectangle AutoShape from Change Shape (Shapes group on Format) while preserving its formatting and text. Enabled on SmartArt Format when one or more inner SmartArt node shapes are selected inside the diagram (or when a 3-D SmartArt style is active for Edit in 2-D). State rule: acts as a one-shot shape-geometry replacement tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Quick Styles
behaviour: Displays the Quick Styles gallery in the Shape Styles group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on SmartArt Format when a SmartArt diagram or inner node shape is selected in an editable document to customize shape fill, outline, and effects. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

Enabled on SmartArt Format when the outer SmartArt frame or inner shapes are selected (with floating positioning and z-order active when the diagram uses non-inline text wrapping). State rule: highlights the tile matching the active target container or object preset as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when custom settings outside the presets are in effect, and mixed state is not used (operates on a single active container or object at a time).

State rule: appears selected (on) in the Position gallery when the active target container or object matches In Line with Text, unselected (off) when another preset or custom setting applies, and mixed state is not used (operates on a single active container or object at a time).

State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: From Clipboard...
behaviour: Replaces the selected SVG graphic or icon with the graphic currently on the system Clipboard while preserving size and formatting. Enabled when a scalable vector graphic (SVG) or icon is selected in an editable document to replace the graphic or decompose it into editable Office shapes. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Convert to Shape
behaviour: Decomposes the selected SVG graphic or icon into editable individual Office drawing shapes (`GroupShape` of freeforms/paths) so individual vector paths can be edited. Enabled when a scalable vector graphic (SVG) or icon is selected in an editable document to replace the graphic or decompose it into editable Office shapes.

label: Graphics Styles
behaviour: Displays the Graphics Styles gallery in the Graphics Styles group on Graphics Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (GraphicsStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to apply preset graphic styles, fill colors, outline strokes, and visual effects. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: Bring Forward
behaviour: Moves the selected floating object one step higher in the drawing z-order stack. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). behaviour: Sets the selected object's text wrapping to In Front of Text so it floats above the document body text layer. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). label: Align Top

Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Align Middle
behaviour: Centers the selected floating objects vertically relative to each other, the page margins, or the page height. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Align Bottom
behaviour: Aligns the bottom edges of the selected floating objects (to the lowest selected object, or to the bottom page margin/edge when Align to Margin or Align to Page is active). Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Distribute Horizontally

Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Distribute Vertically

State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Align to Page is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Group
behaviour: Opens the Group dropdown menu in the Arrange group on Graphics Format to present its child commands and submenus. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping).

label: Group
behaviour: Combines the two or more currently selected floating objects into a single grouped object that moves, resizes, and rotates as one unit. Enabled on Graphics Format when two or more floating objects are multi-selected on the canvas; disabled when a single object is selected. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Ungroup
behaviour: Breaks the selected grouped drawing object apart into its constituent individual shapes or pictures. Enabled on Graphics Format when an existing grouped object is selected; disabled when an ungrouped object is selected. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Rotate
behaviour: Displays the Rotate gallery in the Arrange group on Graphics Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ObjectRotateGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Rotate Right 90°
behaviour: Rotates or flips the selected object by applying Rotate Right 90° from Rotate (Arrange group on Graphics Format), with live preview on hover. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document (with z-order and alignment commands active when the graphic uses floating text wrapping). State rule: acts as a one-shot rotation or flip command tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open gallery, and mixed state is not used).

label: Rotate Left 90°

label: Crop
behaviour: Executes the default Crop command in the Size group on Graphics Format when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Crop dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: the primary button reflects the active Crop mode or pane state (checked/on when Crop is active in the document or window, unchecked/off when inactive, and mixed state is not used because Crop is strictly binary on/off).

label: Crop
behaviour: Toggles or selects the Crop mode from the Crop menu (Size group on Graphics Format). Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: shows a check mark or radio indicator (on) when Crop is the active document, view, or object setting, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Crop to Shape
behaviour: Selects or expands the Crop to Shape submenu under Crop (Size group on Graphics Format). Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Aspect Ratio
behaviour: Selects or expands the Aspect Ratio submenu under Crop (Size group on Graphics Format). Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Fill
behaviour: Scales and centers the selected picture or graphic so it completely fills the current crop frame without distorting its aspect ratio, cropping any overflow edges. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Fit
behaviour: Scales the selected picture or graphic so the entire image fits inside the current crop frame without distortion, leaving letterbox margins if aspect ratios differ. Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Rectangle

Enabled when an SVG graphic or icon is selected in an editable document to crop or resize its height and width. State rule: appears selected (on) in the Crop to Shape gallery when the active target container or object matches Rectangle, unselected (off) when another preset or custom setting applies, and mixed state is not used (operates on a single active container or object at a time).

label: Outlining
behaviour: Appears as a mode tab at the left of the ribbon when the active document window switches to Outline view (View Type wdOutlineView); hosts heading level promotion/demotion, paragraph movement, outline expansion/collapse, level filtering and master/subdocument management.

label: Promote to Heading 1
behaviour: Promotes the selected paragraph(s) directly to top-level `Heading 1` (Outline Level 1) in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Promote
behaviour: Promotes the selected paragraph(s) one outline heading level higher (for example from `Heading 3` to `Heading 2`) in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Outline Level
behaviour: Selects and assigns the outline heading level (Level 1 through Level 9, or Body Text) for the selected paragraph(s) in the Outline Tools group on Outlining. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels. State rule: shows the matching Outline Level value as selected (on) when uniform across the selection, unselected (off) for other list entries, and a blank edit field (mixed) when the selection spans multiple Outline Level values.

label: Demote
behaviour: Demotes the selected paragraph(s) one outline heading level lower (for example from `Heading 1` to `Heading 2`) in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Demote to Body Text
behaviour: Converts the selected heading paragraph(s) to normal `Body Text` level in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Move Up
behaviour: Moves the selected outline paragraph(s) (and any collapsed subordinate subtext) above the preceding paragraph in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Move Down
behaviour: Moves the selected outline paragraph(s) (and any collapsed subordinate subtext) below the following paragraph in Outline view. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels.

label: Expand
behaviour: Reveals the next subordinate heading level or body text hidden beneath the selected heading in Outline view. Enabled on Outlining when the insertion point or selection is on a heading or paragraph that has subordinate outline levels or body text (or spans multiple paragraphs); disabled on leaf paragraphs with no subordinate text.

label: Collapse
behaviour: Hides the lowest visible subordinate heading level or body text beneath the selected heading in Outline view. Enabled on Outlining when the insertion point or selection is on a heading or paragraph that has subordinate outline levels or body text (or spans multiple paragraphs); disabled on leaf paragraphs with no subordinate text.

label: Show Level
behaviour: Selects the deepest heading level (Show Level 1 through Show Level 9, or Show All Levels) displayed in the document outline in the Outline Tools group on Outlining. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels. State rule: shows the active Show Level setting as selected (on), unselected (off) for inactive list entries, and mixed state is not used (always displays the single active setting).

label: Show Text Formatting
behaviour: Shows or hides full character font formatting on headings and body text in Outline view (displaying plain draft fonts when unchecked for faster structural reading). Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when rich text formatting is shown in Outline view, unchecked (off) when draft font display is used, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Show First Line Only
behaviour: Truncates each multi-line paragraph in Outline view to display only its first line (followed by an ellipsis) or expands paragraphs to show all lines. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (`View -> Outline`) to promote, demote, reorder, expand, collapse, or filter outline heading levels. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Outline view displays only the first line of each paragraph, unchecked (off) when full paragraphs are shown, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Show Document
behaviour: Expands or hides the Master Document subdocument management tools (Collapse Subdocuments, Create, Unlink, Merge, Split, Lock Document) in the Master Document group on Outlining and shows or hides subdocument frames. Enabled while the active document window is in Outline view (with Collapse Subdocuments active after Show Document is toggled on in a master document containing subdocuments). State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when Master Document subdocument view and controls are expanded in Outline view, unchecked (off) when hidden, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Collapse Subdocuments
behaviour: Collapses all expanded subdocuments in the active master document into locked file-path hyperlinks, or expands collapsed subdocument links back into editable inline subdocument content. Enabled on Outlining in Master Document view (after Show Document is enabled and when the master document contains subdocuments); disabled when Master Document controls are collapsed or no subdocuments exist. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when subdocuments in the master document are collapsed to file hyperlinks, unchecked (off) when expanded inline, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Close Outline View
behaviour: Exits Outline view and returns the document window to Print Layout view. Enabled whenever Outline view is active to exit Outline view and return to Print Layout view.

label: Zoom...
behaviour: Opens the Zoom modal dialog while in Print Preview to select a preset or custom zoom percentage. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to change the preview magnification or fit one/multiple pages in the viewport.
Sets the Print Preview viewport magnification directly to 100%. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to change the preview magnification or fit one/multiple pages in the viewport.

label: One Page
behaviour: Scales the Print Preview viewport so a single full page fits inside the window. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to change the preview magnification or fit one/multiple pages in the viewport.

label: Multiple Pages
behaviour: Scales the Print Preview viewport to display two or more pages side by side. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to change the preview magnification or fit one/multiple pages in the viewport.

label: Page Width
behaviour: Scales the Print Preview viewport so the page width fills the window horizontally. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to change the preview magnification or fit one/multiple pages in the viewport.

label: Show Ruler
behaviour: Shows or hides the horizontal and vertical page rulers inside the Print Preview viewport. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to toggle rulers/magnifier, shrink trailing text by one page, navigate pages, or close Print Preview. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the page rulers are visible in Print Preview, unchecked (off) when hidden, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Magnifier
behaviour: Switches the Print Preview mouse pointer between the Magnifier zoom cursor (where clicking the page toggles between 100% zoom and full-page fit) and the normal text-editing I-beam insertion pointer. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to toggle rulers/magnifier, shrink trailing text by one page, navigate pages, or close Print Preview. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) when the Magnifier click-to-zoom pointer is active in Print Preview, unchecked (off) when the normal editing cursor is active, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Shrink One Page
behaviour: Reduces the document's font sizes slightly to fit trailing text from the final page onto the preceding page, reducing total page count by one. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to toggle rulers/magnifier, shrink trailing text by one page, navigate pages, or close Print Preview.

label: Next Page
behaviour: Scrolls the Print Preview viewport forward to display the next page of the document. Enabled on Print Preview when the document contains a subsequent (Next Page) or preceding (Previous Page) page relative to the currently previewed page; disabled at the last or first page respectively.

label: Previous Page
behaviour: Scrolls the Print Preview viewport backward to display the preceding page of the document. Enabled on Print Preview when the document contains a subsequent (Next Page) or preceding (Previous Page) page relative to the currently previewed page; disabled at the last or first page respectively.

label: Close Print Preview
behaviour: Exits legacy Print Preview mode and returns the document window to its previous editing view. Enabled while legacy Print Preview mode is active to toggle rulers/magnifier, shrink trailing text by one page, navigate pages, or close Print Preview.

label: Background Removal
behaviour: Appears as a modal editing tab when Remove Background is invoked on a selected picture; hosts foreground mark-to-keep and background mark-to-remove brushes, mark deletion, discard changes and keep changes.

label: Mark Areas to Keep
behaviour: Arms the green foreground marking pencil in Background Removal so drawing over a region of the picture marks that area to be retained in the final cropped image. Enabled while the interactive Background Removal refinement session is active for a selected picture to mark foreground areas to keep or background areas to remove. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Mark Areas to Keep foreground pencil is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Mark Areas to Remove
behaviour: Arms the red background marking pencil in Background Removal so drawing over a region of the picture marks that area to be erased into transparency. Enabled while the interactive Background Removal refinement session is active for a selected picture to mark foreground areas to keep or background areas to remove. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Mark Areas to Remove background pencil is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Discard All Changes
behaviour: Cancels the Background Removal session without modifying the selected picture and returns to Picture Format. Enabled while the interactive Background Removal session is active to discard all mask changes or commit the background removal.

label: Keep Changes
behaviour: Commits the current foreground/background mask to remove the magenta-highlighted background region from the selected picture and returns to Picture Format. Enabled while the interactive Background Removal session is active to discard all mask changes or commit the background removal.
